input: Plan a three-course dinner from a new cookbook

gold.taskTitle: Plan a Three-Course Dinner from New Cookbook
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a three-course dinner by selecting and preparing recipes from a cookbook the user has not cooked from before.

questions.title: Which specific cookbook are you cooking from?
questions.description: Identify the exact cookbook title and author so recipe selection is scoped correctly.

questions.title: How many people are you cooking this dinner for?
questions.description: Determine the number of guests to plan portions, shopping quantities, and kitchen logistics.

questions.title: What is the occasion or reason for this dinner?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a casual weeknight meal, a romantic dinner, a dinner party, or a special celebration.

questions.title: When exactly are you planning to serve this dinner?
questions.description: Pin down the date and time so prep schedules and shopping deadlines can be built around it.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions or allergies to consider?
questions.description: Identify any ingredients or food groups that must be avoided when selecting the three courses.

questions.title: What is your current confidence level in the kitchen?
questions.description: Gauge cooking skill level to recommend recipes that are appropriately challenging without being overwhelming.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for ingredients and supplies?
questions.description: Understand any spending constraints so recipe choices and shopping lists stay within range.
